title: The relative movable cone conjecture for K-trivial fibrations in varieties with well-clipped movable cones
summary: We prove the weak relative Kawamata-Morrison movable cone conjecture for K-trivial fibrations whose very general fibre is a quotient, by a finite group of automorphisms acting freely in codimension one, of a product of certain Calabi-Yau pairs whose underlying varieties have well-clipped movable cones, a notion recently introduced by Cécile Gachet.
